S3_f_peak.basis: S3's 1.25-2.5 GHz window is EXACTLY one octave; 0.5 is its half-width

S3_peaking.basis: distance outside the 3-12 dB band; 1 dB is production CTLE tuning granularity (RewardConfig.peaking_tol_db)

S3_nyq_boost.basis: boost at Nyquist below 0 dB; 1 dB below its own DC gain is meaningfully worse than a wire (CLAUDEwa.md §3 reading (b))

S5_noise.basis: one third of S5's 1.5 mV_rms limit

S6_power.basis: one third of S6's 15 mW limit

saturation.basis: vds - vdsat; 0.28 V at the corrected reference point, so 0.1 V is a third of the way to triode

tail_saturation.basis: vds_tail - vdsat_tail. THE tolerance the reward retraction is about: session 13's tail misses are tens of mV and must not be invisible next to a 17 GHz f_peak miss

action_space.name: w_in
action_space.provenance: s3_yield.PROPOSED_BOX: gm/I_D 5.62 at W=20 um rising to 14.36 at W=100 um; ceiling is the SKY130 W bin limit

action_space.name: l_in
action_space.provenance: s3_yield.PROPOSED_BOX: 0.15 um is the minimum L bin; at 1.0 um peaking is 2.37 dB, already below S3

action_space.name: i_bias
action_space.provenance: s3_yield.PROPOSED_BOX: TOTAL supply current; ceiling is S6 at 1.8 V (8 mA x 1.8 V = 14.4 mW)

action_space.name: rs
action_space.provenance: s3_yield.PROPOSED_BOX: FULL source-to-source; Rs=50 gives 0.08 dB peaking, Rs=800 gives 13.25 dB, through S3's ceiling

action_space.name: cs
action_space.provenance: s3_yield.PROPOSED_BOX: Cs <= 200 fF produces no peak at all; 6.4 pF puts f_peak at 1.047 GHz, below the S3 window

action_space.name: rl
action_space.provenance: s3_yield.PROPOSED_BOX: per side; RL=50 puts f_peak at 5.75 GHz, RL=1000 takes the pair out of saturation

action_space.name: vcm_in
action_space.provenance: s3_yield.PROPOSED_BOX: v(s1) tracks VCM almost 1:1; floor needs v(s1) >= ~0.2 V for a real tail

action_space.name: tail_j
action_space.provenance: TAIL_DEVICE.md sec 6: 82.9k is the INTERPOLATED triode floor at ss/0.95/125 C, 267k is where the tail's own source capacitance moves S3 peaking by +1.06 dB. The rule value is 111.2k

action_space.name: l_tail
action_space.provenance: TAIL_DEVICE.md sec 6: at 0.15 um the tail r_o gives away -1.45 dB of peaking; past 1.0 um the headroom costs 2.27x the width
